{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wrap-style midi dress, sleeveless with a V neckline, fitted waist and flowing A-line skirt falling to mid-calf, in deep sage green (#5E7F73), silk crepe with a soft satin sheen. The back is covered, and the bare arms are the only open zone.

Block-heeled sandals with an ankle strap, mid-height heel, in warm nude (#D8B79B), smooth leather

Envelope clutch, small, in soft gold (#C9A96A), silk satin

Drop earrings, medium length, in polished gold (#C9A96A), metal with a small pearl

Thin bangle bracelet in polished gold (#C9A96A), metal

This outfit meets the formal level for a close family member with a dress of noble fabric and heeled shoes, and the midi length keeps it elegant without feeling like a gown. The deep sage picks up the grey-green of her eyes and glows against her warm skin and golden hair, while staying well clear of white and ivory so the bride stays the focus. Silk crepe is light and breathable for an August afternoon outdoors, and the flowing skirt moves easily from the ceremony to the restaurant. Block heels stay steady on grass, and the gold details add a festive finish for the evening without any need for an outer layer."}
